tables.title: Specimen Bolt Line Forces at Approximate Maximum Measured Moment
tables.role: Each specimen at a sampled averaging interval around maximum measured moment, not necessarily maximum applied vertical load.
tables.source_processing_note: Page103 says data variability prompted a sampled average between measured-moment extremes. The interval was selected using the controlling specimen and also applied to the opposing specimen. Do not equate this to an instantaneous load peak or two independent tests.

tables.title: Initial Failure Mechanism and Bolt Line Forces for the Tested Shear Tab Connections
tables.role: Initial failure stage; one controlling connection specimen per test.

footnotes.a: Initial connection misalignment led to uneven middle-bolt bearing to facilitate erection.
footnotes.b: Testing interrupted due to initial reversal of hydraulic couplings.

tables.title: Secondary Failure Mechanism and Bolt Line Forces for the Tested Shear Tab Connections
tables.role: Secondary failure stage; absent or unperformed stages remain explicit.

footnotes.a: Secondary failure was not attainable due to initial tension rupture.
footnotes.b: Loading was not continued to a secondary failure.
footnotes.c: Initial tension rupture unzipped the shear plate; secondary failure was not reached.

tables.internal_source_difference: Footnote a is printed for3ST1 as well as3ST2/3, but Table4.2 identifies3ST1 initial failure as bolt-shear rupture. Preserve the discrepancy rather than relabeling either source entry.

tables.title: Experimental Data Statics Verification
tables.role: A selected statics-verification state, not failure-peak samples or group means/COVs.
tables.merged_cell_note: The original test-error cell spans L/R rows. It is duplicated in this row representation for location clarity, not two independent error observations.
tables.5ST1_footnote: Data not evaluated due to invalid collection before connection failure.
tables.quality_note: Pages106–107 question3STL3 due to spikes and the statics check; later evaluations exclude that specimen, not the3STR3 controlling failure result.

distance_roles.x_f: true pin to supported column flange face

source_definitions.Delta_n_definition: vertical deflection measured by DWT at timestep n, inches
source_definitions.theta_n_definition: beam end rotation at timestep n, radians
source_definitions.interpretation_limit: The printed equation has horizontal distance divided by displacement. It is not silently corrected to atan(Delta/x_f); a geometry conversion based on that reciprocal would require an explicit hypothesis, not be a literal reproduction.

source_definitions.role: Statics check uses strain-gage forces at selected load states. These equations do not alone make Table4.4 an ultimate-load dataset.

additional_context.observation: The study reports invalid left strain-gage1 and right gage6 data and uses left2/3 and right5/8 channels for force recovery. Resulting moment/axial entries are processed strain-derived quantities, not direct load-cell readings of those components.

For5ST1, initial data before about0.06rad were neglected after a reversed-hydraulic-coupling problem; test and data collection restarted near maximum flexural capacity. Initial and secondary failure values are still printed in Tables4.2/4.3. Thus invalid initial history is not blanket absence of every test quantity.
Tables4.1 maximum moment,4.2 initial failure and4.3 secondary failure have different sampling/physical roles. No dataset is relabeled TN1749 ultimate-load observations at transcription time.

pending_calculation_selection: Original table-field means/COVs may be computed after declaring grouping and stage choices. Total-load conversion, peak selection and original-to-TN rotation mapping remain separate named diagnostics; no unprinted histories or missing observations are imputed.
